explanation: A biome is a major terrestrial ecosystem defined by its distinct climate and geographic features. Each biome is composed of a specific assemblage of plants and animals adapted to those environmental conditions. Biomes tend to repeat in different regions of the globe wherever temperature and precipitation patterns are similar. They support characteristic animal communities, although some animals migrate between biomes. Climatic conditions and the distribution of biomes change predictably as one increases either latitude (distance from the equator) or altitude (elevation).
